item.text:
**Assessment**  
Mostly negative. Jokowi did not show clear respect for institutional distance in 2024: the record points to dynastic advantage, state-linked content control, and election-related institutional pressure. The strongest positive evidence is limited to the court process and the constitutional handover, not to a broader pattern of keeping neutral institutions untouched.

**Accepted Claims**
- [Indonesia leader accused of bias, interference in presidential election](https://theprint.in/world/indonesia-leader-accused-of-bias-interference-in-presidential-election/1948656/) - Reuters, 2024-02-01. Claim: Jokowi faced public criticism for perceived non-neutrality, including highly publicized appearances with Prabowo while his son was on the ticket. This is direct negative evidence for avoiding politicization of neutral state institutions. IDs: 4B.5, 4B.2, 4B.1
- [Indonesia students protest alleged poll interference by Jokowi administration](https://theprint.in/world/indonesia-students-protest-alleged-poll-interference-by-jokowi-administration/1963424/) - Reuters via ThePrint, 2024-02-12. Claim: Students and activists protested what they saw as Jokowi’s abuse of power to sway the election. This supports a negative finding on intimidation, capture, and institutional politicization. IDs: 4B.5, 4B.2, 4B.1, 4B.3
- [Indonesia court rejects election disputes, upholding president-elect Prabowo’s win](https://theprint.in/world/indonesia-court-rejects-election-disputes-upholding-president-elect-prabowos-win/2051390/) - Reuters via ThePrint, 2024-04-22. Claim: The Constitutional Court said there was no evidence of systematic fraud or presidential meddling. This is the strongest positive evidence that formal institutions were still able to constrain the ruler. IDs: 4B.5, 4B.1, 4B.4
- [Indonesia court rejects election challenges, upholding Prabowo’s win](https://theprint.in/world/indonesia-court-rejects-election-challenges-upholds-prabowos-win/2051948/) - Reuters via ThePrint, 2024-04-22. Claim: The disputes still centered on allegations of state neutrality problems and nepotism. That makes the court ruling only a limited positive signal, not evidence that Jokowi kept neutral institutions politically insulated. IDs: 4B.5, 4B.1, 4B.2, 4B.4
- [Poll shows Jokowi's approval rating falls after protests, but still popular](https://www.thejakartapost.com/indonesia/2024/10/05/poll-shows-jokowis-approval-rating-falls-after-protests-but-still-popular) - Reuters via The Jakarta Post, 2024-10-05. Claim: Allies’ August election-rule push would have helped Jokowi’s youngest son and triggered backlash. This is strong evidence of rule-bending to preserve family advantage rather than respecting institutional neutrality. IDs: 4B.5, 4B.2, 4B.1, 4B.4
- [A decade of Jokowi: Indonesia’s democracy icon leaves illiberal legacy, critics say](https://theprint.in/world/analysis-a-decade-of-jokowi-indonesias-democracy-icon-leaves-illiberal-legacy-critics-say/2310394/) - Reuters via ThePrint, 2024-10-14. Claim: Reuters said Jokowi left behind patronage, dynastic politics, and weaker institutional integrity. This is broad but important negative evidence for personality-cult-like politics, party/network capture, and politicization of institutions. IDs: 4B.5, 4B.1, 4B.2, 4B.4
- [Indonesia: Freedom on the Net 2024](https://freedomhouse.org/country/indonesia/freedom-net/2024) - Freedom House, 2024. Claim: Ahead of the February 2024 election, Bawaslu formed a social-media monitoring task force with KPU, Kominfo, and police cyber units to order takedowns of “hoax” and polarizing content, while Kominfo retained direct content-restriction powers without an appeals process. This is strong evidence of politicized or overbroad use of state institutions in the electoral-information space. IDs: 4B.5, 4B.2, 4B.3, 3B.8, 3B.9
- [Indonesia: Freedom on the Net 2024](https://freedomhouse.org/country/indonesia/freedom-net/2024) - Freedom House, 2024. Claim: Government critics, journalists, and internet users continued to face criminal prosecution, violent attacks, and harassment; anonymous political buzzers also attacked opposition supporters. This is negative evidence for intimidation and for creating a loyalty-enforcing political environment. IDs: 4B.5, 4B.3, 3B.8, 3B.9
- [Farewell-Welcome Ceremony for Indonesia’s President from Jokowi to Prabowo Subianto](https://setkab.go.id/en/farewell-welcome-ceremony-for-indonesias-president-from-jokowi-to-prabowo-subianto/) - Sekretariat Kabinet Republik Indonesia, 2024-10-20. Claim: Jokowi formally transferred power to Prabowo on inauguration day. This is a limited positive signal that he ultimately accepted the constitutional transition rather than clinging to office through overt institutional capture. IDs: 4B.5, 4B.1, 4B.4

**Search Gap**
- I did not find strong direct evidence of a classic personal cult or explicit loyalty tests in 2024.
- The available evidence instead points mainly to dynastic/patronage politics, content-control tools, and election-period institutional pressure, which is enough for a negative but not a full “cult” finding.
